title: 第116章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏落云没有接话,可是调配香料的手却慢了下来。她倒是知道上将军如此铁石心肠的原因。

若王皇后真的害死了慧娘，那么公主与将军当真是孽缘一段，绝对无法善了。

不过赵栋一直没有同儿子讲出实情,绝了赵归北与渔阳的母子之情，而且也只是要和离，而不是休妻，在苏落云看来，将军其实还是念及了这么多年的夫妻之情的。

那日韩瑶走后，苏落云想了又想,还是决定亲自去驸马府一趟。

虽然在梁州的时候，渔阳公主已经与她撕破了脸,表达了绝交之意。可苏落云却感念着渔阳公主对她的恩情。

算起来，自己当初能脱离父亲和继母，自立门户开香铺子过活，都是因为遇到渔阳公主这位贵人。

她为人虽然自带了皇家的骄纵，但对于出入自己府宅的商贾子女却都大度得很,那时不仅常常破格留下她们这些商贾女子吃宴长见识，能提携的地方,也都很是大方。

这都是渔阳的无心之举，可能她自己都不记得了,可落云却很领这份人情。

冲着这份人情,苏落云也不忍看着她绝食而死。

不过当苏落云带着仆从坐着马车到了驸马府时，那管事却一脸为难道：“太子妃，公主说谁也不见,就是驸马回来了,她也不见……”

落云原以为渔阳这番绝食是在使苦肉计,想要赵栋回心转意,可听管事这么说，倒像是钻了死胡同。

想到这，她也不管公主想不想见她，直接告诉管事，是她自己硬闯的，不管他的事。

管事哪里敢拦太子妃，贵人执意要去看望公主，他也只能一路引路。

不过当苏落云真的亲眼看到渔阳公主时，却是吓了一跳。

别看渔阳的辈分是韩临风的皇姑奶奶，其实只不过人到中年而已，加上平日的精心保养，说不到三十都有人信。

可是现在，渔阳昔日乌黑的秀发，竟然一下白了一半，脂粉未施的脸上，也满是瘦得脱相的憔悴。

“公主，您……您怎么成这个样子了？”

渔阳公主看见如今的太子妃来了，也是一愣，下意识想用衣袖遮住自己没有梳妆的脸，可是手伸到一半，却又觉得徒劳，就此放弃，木然道：“你是特意来看我笑话的？”

苏落云有些恨铁不成钢地瞪着她，冷冷说道：“这世间除了男人能让你作天作地之外，难道再无其他可贵之处？你也眼看着战乱之后，百姓们有的卖儿卖女，只求活着罢了。就算将军跟你和离，你也应该努力振作，怎么能如此自暴自弃，还要绝食明志？你这是明志给谁看？真该将你扔在流民堆里，让你好好体会体会，活着有时候是多么奢侈的事！”

若不是自己的男人成了太子，苏落云还真不敢这么放开胆子骂这位皇姑奶奶。

可是这些话，其实憋在她心里甚久了。

最起码，她以后就算被韩临风抛弃了，也绝对不会要死要活的。

情殇一场，难过是一定的。

但越是这样，她也越要活出个人样子来，就像她说的，人来这世间一次不容易，怎么能轻言放弃？这样的信念，也是支持她熬过那段黑暗眼盲岁月的信念之一。

被这个昔日来自己府上卖香料的小商人如此劈头盖脸地骂了一顿，渔阳公主第一个反应自然是不能忍，挣扎想要坐起，可是她两日没有吃东西，身体实在虚得很。

落云一早就命驸马府的管事预备了稀粥，这时她接过碗，端给了渔阳：“将这个喝了，才有气力骂人！”

渔阳公主想说不喝，却被苏落云将碗送在了嘴边，结果闻着糜烂的粥香，她忍不住喝了一大口。

落云这时又递了一筷子配粥的小菜，腌渍入味的芥菜叶吃上一口就能勾起食欲。

渔阳这辈子都没有这么狼狈地吃下一碗粥，等她吃完了，落云又亲自用湿帕子替她擦了嘴。

渔阳呆愣愣地看着面前这个说着狠话，却行着温柔之事的小女子，眼眶不知不觉间便湿润了，她低低问落云：“你是不是也觉得我当年的执着错了？”

落云如今不必忌讳她的身份，说起话来也直得很：“我虽然不曾了解当时的情况，可是也能体会到赵将军和慧娘的为难。毕竟方家老二跟您当时比起来，也是有过之而无不及。你不是也看到了方二当初为难我时，周围人对我的落井下石吗？你如今还问对错，显然是没吃够其中的苦楚。”

渔阳算是看出了这个女奸商的毒舌，只气道：“我还以为你是宽慰我的！”

落云又喂她喝了些水，然后道：“世间事都是有因果。你当初的执念造成了如今的结果，自然要坦然接受。你这般饿死，难道要给将军留下趋炎附势，虐待妻子而死的罪名吗？我不是来宽慰你的，是不让你继续种下恶果，再继续追悔莫及。”

渔阳听懂了落云的意思，也知道她如今刻薄话语下的恨铁不成钢。

她推开了茶杯，低声道：“我母亲成了废后，想见她一面都不可能。父皇恨赵栋当初未能及时护驾，也不肯见我。唯一的亲弟弟也因为谋反被幽禁。京城中的旧友对我唯恐避之不及。连我昔日的枕边人都骂我是蛇蝎毒妇，不让归北来见我。如今的我，臭不可闻，连我自己都厌弃自己。我先前那般对你，你为何还要来？”

落云坦然道：“你跟上将军的恩怨，是你们的事情，与我何干？我只知道在我最无助的时候，是您提携了我，给了我和弟弟能自立的本钱。这番大恩，没齿难忘。我眼中的公主，一直活得恣意，可不是现在这般消沉的样子。”

听着落云说的话，这几日来，一直沉溺在彷徨无依中的公主终于哽咽地哭出了声来，一把抱住了落云的肩膀，哭得像个无助的孩童。

从渔阳公主的嘴里，落云也终于知道了东平王当初跟驸马爷说了些什么。

Page (1/3)

Su Luoyun didn't answer, but her hands mixing the spices slowed down.She did know the reason why the General was so hard-hearted.

If Queen Wang really killed Hui Niang, then the princess and the general were really in a bad relationship and could never be reconciled.

However, Zhao Dong never told the truth to his son and ended the mother-son love between Zhao Guibei and Yuyang. Moreover, he only wanted to reconcile, not divorce his wife. In Su Luoyun's view, the general still missed the love between husband and wife for so many years.

After Han Yao left that day, Su Luoyun thought about it again and decided to go to the Prince Consort's Mansion in person.

Although when she was in Liangzhou, Princess Yuyang had already broken up with her and expressed her intention to break off the relationship.But Su Luoyun was grateful for Princess Yuyang's kindness to her.

All in all, the reason why I was able to break away from my father and stepmother and start my own incense shop was because I met this noble person, Princess Yuyang.

Although she was born with royal arrogance, she was very generous to the children of merchants who came in and out of her house. At that time, she not only often left them, merchant women, to have banquets to gain experience, but she was also very generous wherever she could support them.

This was all Yuyang's unintentional act. Maybe she didn't even remember it, but Luoyun appreciated the favor.

Because of this favor, Su Luoyun couldn't bear to watch her die on hunger strike.

However, when Su Luoyun and his servants arrived at the Prince Consort's Mansion in a carriage, the steward had a confused look on his face: "Prince Concubine, the princess said she wouldn't see anyone. Even if the Prince Consort comes back, she won't see her either..."

Luoyun originally thought that Yuyang's hunger strike was a ploy to get Zhao Dong to change his mind, but when the manager said this, it seemed like he had hit a dead end.

Thinking of this, she didn't care whether the princess wanted to see her or not, and directly told the steward that she had forced her way in and didn't care about his business.

No matter how the steward dares to stop the princess, the nobleman insists on visiting the princess, so he can only lead the way.

But when Su Luoyun actually saw Princess Yuyang with her own eyes, she was shocked.

Even though Yuyang was Han Linfeng's imperial aunt, she was actually only middle-aged. With her careful maintenance, no one believed her even if she said she was under thirty.

But now, Yuyang's formerly black hair had turned half white in a flash, and his face, which had not been painted with makeup, was also full of skinny and haggard appearance.

"Princess, you...why are you like this?"

When Princess Yuyang saw the current Crown Princess coming, she was also startled. She subconsciously wanted to cover her undressed face with her sleeves, but when she reached halfway, she felt it was futile, so she gave up and said dullly: "You came here specifically to see my joke?"

Su Luoyun stared at her with some hatred, and said coldly: "Apart from the fact that a man can make you the king of heaven and earth, is there anything else valuable in this world? You have also seen that after the war, some people sold their sons and daughters, just to survive. That's all.Even if the general makes peace with you, you should work hard to cheer up.How can you give up on yourself and go on a hunger strike to show your determination?I really should throw you into the homeless and let you realize how luxurious life is sometimes!"

If her man hadn't become the prince, Su Luoyun would not have dared to scold the imperial aunt like this.

But these words had actually been held in her heart for a long time.

At the very least, even if she is abandoned by Han Linfeng in the future, she will never die.

When there is a loss of love, sadness is inevitable.

But the more this happens, the more she has to live her own life. As she said, it is not easy for a person to come to this world once, so how can she give up so easily?This belief was one of the beliefs that supported her through those dark and blind years.

Being scolded so vehemently by this small businessman who used to come to her house to sell spices, Princess Yuyang's first reaction was naturally that she couldn't bear it. She struggled to sit up, but she hadn't eaten for two days and her body was really weak.

Luoyun ordered the steward of the Prince Consort's Mansion to prepare porridge early in the morning. At this time, she took the bowl and gave it to Yuyang: "Drink this, then you will have the strength to curse!"

Princess Yuyang wanted to say not to drink, but Su Luoyun put the bowl to her mouth. As a result, smelling the rotten porridge, she couldn't help but take a big sip.

At this time, Luo Yun handed over a chopstick of side dishes to go with the porridge. One bite of the pickled mustard leaves would whet your appetite.

Yuyang had never eaten a bowl of porridge so embarrassedly in her life. When she finished eating, Luoyun personally wiped her mouth with a wet handkerchief.

Yuyang stared blankly at the little woman in front of him who said cruel words but acted gentle things. His eyes became moist without realizing it. She asked Luoyun in a low voice: "Do you also think that my persistence back then was wrong?"

Luoyun now doesn't have to be taboo about her identity, and she speaks very straightforwardly: "Although I didn't understand the situation at that time, I can still understand the embarrassment of General Zhao and Huiniang. After all, the second son of the Fang family was even worse than you at that time. Didn't you also see that when Fang Er made things difficult for me, the people around me made things worse for me? You are still asking right or wrong now, obviously you have not suffered enough."

Yuyang finally saw the vicious tongue of this female profiteer and said angrily: "I thought you were trying to comfort me!"

Luo Yun fed her some more water, and then said: "Everything in the world has a cause and effect. Your original obsession led to the current results, so naturally you have to accept it calmly. If you starve to death like this, do you want to leave the general with the crime of following someone's influence and abusing his wife to death? I am not here to comfort you, but to prevent you from continuing to sow evil consequences and continue to regret it."

Yuyang understood what Luoyun meant, and also knew that she was filled with hatred beneath her harsh words.

She pushed away the tea cup and whispered: "My mother has become a waste queen, and it is impossible to see her. My father hated Zhao Dong for not being able to escort him in time, and refused to see me. My only biological brother was also imprisoned for treason. The old man in the capitalMy friends are afraid to avoid me.Even my former bedfellows called me a poisonous woman and refused to let me come to see me.Now I am so disgusting that even I despise myself.Why do you still come?"

Luo Yun said calmly: "The grudge you have with the general is your business and what does it have to do with me? I only know that when I was most helpless, it was you who supported me and gave me and my brother the capital to be independent. This great kindness is unforgettable. The princess in my eyes has always lived a wanton life, but she is not as depressed as she is now."

Listening to what Luo Yun said, the princess, who had been immersed in hesitation and helplessness for the past few days, finally burst into tears and hugged Luo Yun's shoulders, crying like a helpless child.

From Princess Yuyang's words, Luoyun finally knew what King Dongping had said to his consort.
